query_basis: fiscal_year=2025 AND (upper(agency_name) like '%COMMUNITY BOARD%' OR upper(agency_name) like '%COMMUNITY BD%')

field_semantics.leave_status_as_of_june_30: Status of employee as of the close of the relevant fiscal year: Active, Ceased, or On Leave.
field_semantics.title_description: Civil service title description of the employee.
field_semantics.regular_gross_paid: Amount paid for base salary during the fiscal year.
field_semantics.total_ot_paid: Total overtime pay paid during the fiscal year.
field_semantics.total_other_pay: Compensation in addition to gross salary and overtime pay, including differentials, lump sums, allowances, retroactive pay, settlements, and bonus pay when applicable.

aggregation.totals: sum by exact payroll_number, agency_name, and leave_status_as_of_june_30
aggregation.titles: row count by exact payroll_number, agency_name, leave_status_as_of_june_30, and title_description
